purpose: Predeclare how a qualified sentiment state may later be tested as a veto-only conditioning variable against otherwise unchanged frozen strategies.

target_strategies.reason: Already frozen multi-symbol directional strategy; sentiment can map causally to long/short entry vetoes without changing the signal generator.
Already frozen ENA directional mean-reversion strategy; provides a coin-specific robustness comparison without creating a new sentiment strategy.

explicit_initial_exclusions.reason: A bullish/bearish single-symbol veto does not map cleanly to the frozen rank-based portfolio construction; adding it would require a separately frozen protocol.

conditioning_mapping.long_rule: skip an otherwise valid long only when the frozen pre-signal sentiment state is at or below the lower threshold
conditioning_mapping.short_rule: skip an otherwise valid short only when the frozen pre-signal sentiment state is at or above the upper threshold

research_rules: State prediction is evaluated before strategy PnL.
The frozen baseline strategy parameters and economics remain unchanged.
Sentiment thresholds cannot be retuned after strategy results are inspected.
The reversed-sentiment arm is retained as an adversarial control rather than discarded when inconvenient.
The primary and secondary strategy order is frozen before sentiment-conditioned PnL is inspected.
Any historical sentiment backtest is development evidence unless a genuinely untouched holdout was frozen before inspection.
No result from this protocol authorizes live order transmission.
